description: Static screening targets. Secrets are declared at the function boundary because taint is not tracked through linear memory: the exported wrappers store their i64 words to memory before calling a verifier, so screening an export would report a false clean. The verifiers are the leaf primitives where the secret arrives as a pointer parameter.

targets.description: naive per-byte loop; the optimizer erases the branch, so this should screen clean despite a secret-dependent source-level if
volatile per-byte loads keep the branch, so the secret must reach a branch condition
subtle::ConstantTimeEq control; the secret must not reach any branch
